title: Pure Fire King
summary: Pure Fire King self-destruction control build led by Legendary Fire King Ponix, Sacred Fire King Garunix, and Fire King Courtier Ulcanix, with generic staples. Destroying your own FIRE monsters in the hand, field, or Deck triggers chain reactions of Special Summons, searches, and Standby Phase board wipes.

summary.title: Starters
points: Legendary Fire King Ponix searches any Fire King Spell or Trap (Fire King Sanctuary or Fire King Sky Burn) on Normal or Special Summon, and returns from the GY to your hand during the next Standby Phase after it is destroyed.

Fire King Courtier Ulcanix destroys 1 other FIRE monster in your hand or face-up field on Normal or Special Summon to search any FIRE Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast (such as Sacred Fire King Garunix or Fire King High Avatar Kirin), and Special Summons Fire King High Avatar Garunix from the Deck when destroyed.
Fire King Sanctuary places Fire King Island face-up directly from your Deck on activation, and Fire King Island destroys 1 monster in your hand or field to search any Fire King monster.

summary.title: Opening: Legendary Fire King Ponix (or Fire King Courtier Ulcanix)
steps: Normal Summon Legendary Fire King Ponix and search Fire King Sanctuary; activate Sanctuary to place Fire King Island in the Field Zone.
Activate Fire King Island, destroying Ponix on the field (or a FIRE monster in hand) to search Sacred Fire King Garunix.

Because a FIRE monster you controlled was destroyed, Sacred Fire King Garunix triggers to Special Summon itself from your hand (or GY), then destroys Fire King Avatar Barong or Fire King High Avatar Kirin directly from your Deck to gain half its ATK.

If you destroyed Fire King High Avatar Kirin from the Deck, Kirin revives a Fire King from your GY and destroys a card on the field; if you destroyed Barong, it searches another Fire King during the next Standby Phase.

summary.title: Self-Destruction & Standby Phase Recursion
summary.text: Whenever a FIRE monster you control is destroyed by battle or card effect, Sacred Fire King Garunix Special Summons itself from either the hand or GY, while Legendary Fire King Ponix, Fire King Avatar Rangbali, Fire King Avatar Barong, and Fire King Avatar Kirin can Special Summon themselves from the hand. On the opponent's turn, Fire King High Avatar Kirin activates in your hand or field as a Quick Effect to destroy another FIRE monster in your hand or field and Special Summon itself—triggering Sacred Fire King Garunix from the GY in the middle of the opponent's plays.

summary.title: Control & Bosses
points: Garunix Eternity, Hyang of the Fire Kings (Rank 8 Xyz) destroys all other monsters on the field when Xyz Summoned, detaches 1 material to destroy a Spell/Trap, and Special Summons Fire King monsters from your GY up to the number of materials it had when destroyed.

Fire King Sanctuary can immediately Xyz Summon a FIRE Xyz Monster (Garunix Eternity using two Level 8s, or Number 59: Crooked Cook using two Level 4s) as a Quick Effect when the opponent Special Summons a monster.

Fire King Avatar Arvata negates any monster effect activation by destroying another FIRE monster in your hand or field, and Fire King Avatar Rangbali negates any Spell or Trap activation the same way.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Fire King Sanctuary can destroy 1 FIRE monster in your hand or field instead whenever Fire King Island would be destroyed by card effect—preventing Island's own field-wipe downside while triggering a FIRE monster's destruction effect.

Fire King Sky Burn destroys an equal number of Fire King monsters you control and cards your opponent controls at Quick-Play speed, and banishes itself from the GY to protect your Fire King cards from destruction.

Echelon of the Fire Kings Special Summons 3 FIRE monsters (1 Beast, 1 Beast-Warrior, and 1 Winged Beast, one each from your hand, Deck, and GY) and prevents the opponent from responding to your Fire King Normal or Special Summons.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Cursed Fire King Doom Burst requires a Fiend Tuner and belongs to Archfiend/Sinful Spoils hybrids rather than Pure Fire King.
